items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: I would beat you all the way to Bob Thiele's Fields office and make you sign.

ctx.x: Bob Field. He says, "They've offered me 10 grand," he says, "But man, I can't leave you." I said, "Look, if I had a stick I would beat you all the way to Bob Thiele's Fields office and make you sign." So that was -- so he says, "Really, Klook Kluke?" I said, "Look," I said, "As long as I've been in New York, I've never had anyone offer me $10,000.00." I said, "If you don't take that $10,000.00, I'll kill you and ship you back to Florida." And he took the -- from then on -- well, we went to -- with his -- he…
